A Hidden Gem That Feels Like Home
Oct 2024 • Friends
I stumbled upon Hẹ Studio quite by chance, with no great expectations in mind when I decided to visit. But to my surprise, the experience exceeded everything I could have imagined. In the cozy warmth of this little house, it felt as if I were enjoying a meal at my own home after days of traveling around.
The dishes were thoughtfully prepared, delicious, and plentiful. What stood out the most was the dessert – dried persimmons, artfully and delicately presented by Hải Anh, the owner of Hẹ Studio. The natural sweetness and soft, chewy texture of the persimmons perfectly rounded off the evening, leaving a lasting impression.
I’m sharing my experience to encourage you to visit Hẹ Studio and make Hải Anh delightfully busy with your special requests. Trust me, you won’t be disappointed!

With gratitude and warmth,

What a lovely dinner in a hidden gem in Nha Trang!
Nov 2024 • Friends
I lived in Nha Trang from 2015 to 2017, and IcePan Artisan Ice Cream, made in Hẹ Studio, was one of my absolute favorites. The ice cream is incredibly tasty, with unique flavors that set it apart. Even more impressive, the quality has remained consistently excellent over the past nine years.

When we heard that Hẹ Studio also serves dinner, my friend and I couldn’t resist trying it out. The meal featured delicious Nha Trang specialty dishes, beautifully presented on a well-decorated dining table. I cannot forget the owner Hai Anh's newly-creative Western-style dessert with persimmon and mango. All the dishes are well matched with the wine. The dining hall itself is a feast for the eyes, adorned with Hai Anh's art and book collections, which add a personal and artistic touch.

One of the highlights of the evening was chatting with Hai Anh during the dinner. She shared captivating stories about daily life in Nha Trang and her creative passions and love for Nha Trang, making the experience feel warm and personal.

The next day, we are so happy that we decide to return to Hẹ Studio’s attached café to enjoy the coffee and ice cream. The café is charmingly decorated, and we especially loved watching the trains pass by—it added a unique and nostalgic vibe to our visit.

A Hidden Gem of Culinary and Cultural Delight
Nov 2024 • Friends
We had the pleasure of dining at Hẹ Studio after finding it on TripAdvisor, and it exceeded all our expectations. Tucked away from the bustling streets, this intimate space offers a serene, beautifully curated atmosphere with tasteful decor. The host is an incredibly knowledgeable and cultured individual with a successful 10-year business background, making for fascinating conversations.

The Vietnamese cuisine was delicious and perfectly balanced. We even got to help prepare the fried mackerel with sour mango, a fun and memorable experience! Time flew as we immersed ourselves in the meal and conversation, finishing the evening at 11:00 PM. Highly recommend for anyone seeking an authentic and heartfelt dining experience in Nha Trang.
